skills.name: Pressure of Death
skills.description: Exudes a pure blue aura. Good effects on allies.   *Move Speed +120% (10 sec) *Evade Rate +40% (10 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +40% (10 sec)

skills.name: Light Speed Attack
skills.description: Attacks at light speed. Bad effects on enemies.   *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *Stuns enemies (4 sec) *Switches places with enemies

abilities.name: Group: Fire Force
abilities.description: Fire Force Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Persistence
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability have a high chance of activating Persistence when defeated. Persistence allows these Rangers to hold on for 7 more seconds with a big ATK increase.
